name: assume_init_mut
declaration: const unsafe fn assume_init_mut (& mut self) -> & mut [T]
documentation:
Gets a mutable (unique) reference to the contained value.

 # Safety

 Calling this when the content is not yet fully initialized causes undefined
 behavior: it is up to the caller to guarantee that every `MaybeUninit<T>` in the
 slice really is in an initialized state. For instance, `.assume_init_mut()` cannot
 be used to initialize a `MaybeUninit` slice.
rules: Before calling `assume_init_mut`, the caller must ensure that every `MaybeUninit<T>` in `self` is fully initialized; calling it with any uninitialized element causes undefined behavior. In particular, `assume_init_mut` cannot be used to initialize a `MaybeUninit` slice.
